title: quire coverage --json payload (v1)
description: The FR-050 coverage rollup as emitted on stdout by `quire coverage --json` and by `CoverageReport::to_json`. Hand-authored: `schemars` is banned in this crate (FR-003-AC-4) precisely so this artifact is a decision rather than a derivation, and so a payload change cannot silently rewrite its own contract. FR-008-AC-5 bans a version key in the payload, so the version lives here in the `$id` and the filename.

unbacked_rows.description: FR-050-AC-3: reference rows answerable for trace ids no symbol backs.

status_lies.description: FR-050-AC-4: rows whose status classes as complete while nothing backs them.

no_symbol_rows.description: FR-050-AC-16 (CR-041): unbacked rows exempted from status_lies by a declared method that mints no source symbol. ABSENT — not empty — for a module declaring no `no_source_symbol` vocabulary, which is what keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity.

undeclared_statuses.description: FR-050-AC-21 (CR-083): rows whose authored status value the module's `traceability.status` vocabulary classes as nothing. ABSENT — not empty — for a corpus whose every status value is declared, which is what keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity. Additive under FR-055-CON-3: no existing key changes meaning, no required key is added, and a consumer written against this schema before the key existed reads an unchanged payload from a conformant corpus.

untracked_symbols.description: FR-050-AC-5: source symbols whose trace tag resolves to no declared target or reference row.

shared_trace_ids.description: FR-050-AC-23 (CR-087): trace ids bound by more than one distinct source symbol. One id names one symbol; a row backed by N symbols stays green while N-1 of its tests rot. ABSENT — not empty — for a corpus whose every id is uniquely bound, which is what keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity. Carries no weight in `totals`, and `--strict` does not gate on it in this revision. Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

groups.description: FR-050-AC-6: backed/total counts per minting document and target kind.

minted_targets.description: FR-050-AC-38 (#361): row-level identity and backed state behind groups and totals. ABSENT only when the model minted no rows; additive under FR-055-CON-3.

criteria.description: FR-050-AC-13 (CR-028): per-document property-shape counts. Absent for a corpus binding no criteria.

diagnostics.description: CR-054: declarations that selected nothing, and why. Absent when every declaration selected something.

diagnostic_reason_registry.description: agent-ix/quire-rs#300: every stable reason token this engine can emit in diagnostics, in deterministic registry order. Always emitted by current engines; optional in v1 so payloads from older engines remain readable under FR-055-CON-3.

obligations.description: FR-053: derived obligation records, ordered by source then document then row. Absent for a model declaring no `obligations:` sources.

implements.description: FR-062: requirement -> production-code edges. Absent for a module declaring no `implements` marker forms. Carries no weight in `totals` — scope is not evidence.

vocabulary_coverage.description: FR-059-AC-9 (CR-091, #179): one record per declared coverage-vocabulary value, classified owned / excused / unowned with the deciding documents. The `quire validate` warning stream reports only the unowned residue; these records let a consumer tell an owned value from an excused one without opening bundle frontmatter. ABSENT — not empty — for a module declaring no `vocabulary_coverage`, which is what keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity. Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

excluded_source_files.description: FR-050-AC-24 (#215): source files a declared `source_exclude` glob removed from the symbol walk. ABSENT — never 0 — for a model declaring no `source_exclude` or one whose globs match nothing, which is what keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity. Additive under FR-055-CON-3. Without it an over-broad glob silently drops legitimate backing and the report reads as a coverage regression.

binding_census.description: FR-050-AC-27 / FR-051-AC-19 (CR-093, #227): what the trace binder examined and what bound, per language. Unlike every other list here this is not a defect list — it is the premise the backed/total ratio rests on, so it is present whenever the code walk found an evidence symbol, whether or not anything bound. `1292 candidates, 0 bound` is the shape that produced a confident 23% over a corpus the binder could not read; `1292 candidates, 1290 bound` is a reassurance no earlier payload could give. ABSENT only when no language yielded an evidence symbol. Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

unmatched_tags.description: FR-050-AC-39 (#362): generic trace-id tokens in evidence-symbol annotation blocks that no declared form bound on that symbol. Each record is row-addressable and engine-parsed, so consumers do not duplicate adapter boundaries or mistake id-shaped test-body data for a tag. ABSENT when empty; additive under FR-055-CON-3.

metrics.description: FR-063 (CR-094, #229): every headline number this payload emits, with its unit, population, method and match count. The generalization of `binding_census` — that field names the one premise `backed/total` happens to rest on; this makes stating the premise a property of every ratio, so a percentage cannot be emitted without the counts that say whether it measured anything. Always emitted by the engine; OPTIONAL here so a payload from an engine predating the field still conforms (FR-055-CON-3).

suspicions.description: FR-064 (CR-100, #235/#236): things that look wrong, with the measurement that made them look wrong. ADVISORY ALWAYS — a suspicion is a claim about a shape, not a verdict; it affects no total and no exit code. These are the finding classes only manual review caught in battletest pass 2. ABSENT for a corpus whose suites all check every sample, which keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity.

EngineProvenance.description: Which instrument produced this payload (agent-ix/quire-cli#68, CR-104). Assembled by `quire-cli`, which is the only layer that knows both versions; ABSENT from a payload built by calling `CoverageReport::to_json` in-process, and absent from any CLI predating the field. NOT the contract version — that stays in the `$id` and the filename, and FR-055-CON-2 still forbids a payload key naming it. This is provenance of the MEASUREMENT: a current CLI can link a stale engine, and every number in this payload is only as trustworthy as the engine that computed it.

engine.description: The resolved `quire-rs` version actually linked, read from the consuming crate's lockfile entry — specifically the `?tag=` / `?rev=` / `?branch=` locator in that entry's `source` field, or the commit sha where the locator is absent. NOT the entry's `version` field: for a git dependency that field is the dependency's own manifest constant, and this crate's manifest has read `0.33.0` at every tag from v0.42.0 through v0.45.0, so reading it would restate the defect one layer down. A `-<n>-g<sha>` suffix, a bare rev, or a branch name is carried VERBATIM and never rounded to the nearest tag: the whole defect is a binary claiming a version it does not have.

capabilities.description: What this build can emit, as tokens. DELIBERATELY OPEN, and deliberately not version arithmetic: a consumer asserts it needs `binding_census`, not that the engine is `>= 0.43.0`, because a version comparison in a consumer is a second place the contract lives. A newer CLI adding a token must not break a consumer written against an older one.

Metric.description: One emitted number and its provenance. `state` discriminates: a measurement that RAN carries value/population/matched; one that did not carries `because` and no numbers at all, so 'not computed' can never be read as a zero (#226).

population.description: The denominator, in `unit`. Zero is legitimate — measuring nothing and saying so is honest (FR-050-AC-14).

examined.description: How many INPUTS the measurement was offered, in whatever unit `method` names — source symbols walked, criteria reaching the classifier, rows reconciled.

matched.description: How many of those inputs it successfully read. Paired with `examined` because their difference is the point: matched 0 of examined 0 means there was nothing to read and the zero is honest; matched 0 of examined 1292 means the measurement was handed its input and could not read any of it — the shape that produced a confident 23% over a corpus the binder could not parse.

because.description: The condition that decided it, in the engine's own vocabulary — 'the module declares no `implements` marker forms', not 'no data'.

MetricName.description: Stable dotted token — `coverage.backed`. Machine-joinable, never rendered prose.

MetricUnit.description: What ONE of `value` is: `matrix row`, `acceptance criterion`, `production symbol`. Singular, so a reader can say '555 matrix rows'.

MetricMethod.description: How the number was arrived at, and what `matched` counts for it — written for somebody deciding whether to trust the ratio.

MetricShape.description: Whether `value` is a share of `population` or a tally in its own right (CR-102, #229). HOLLOWNESS IS A PROPERTY OF RATIOS ONLY: for a `count`, `matched` and `value` are the same fact, so `matched: 0` reports the finding rather than a failure to look. `coverage.implements` read 0 of 42 production symbols on agent-ix/spec-artifacts-process and was reported as arithmetic over nothing; the honest report is '0 of 42'. Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

language.description: The stable language label the symbol identities use.

candidates.description: Evidence symbols examined — those whose kind admits a trace tag (test function, benchmark, fuzz target). A container or a production function is never a candidate (CR-061), so this is not a count of all symbols.

tagged.description: Candidates whose attached annotation block carries a generic id-shaped token, whether or not the declared grammar can read it. Bound candidates always count as tagged, preserving bound <= tagged <= candidates.

bound.description: Candidates that minted at least one `verifies` relation. Counts SYMBOLS, not relations: a test carrying five ids counts once, so a handful of heavily-tagged tests cannot hide a thousand unreadable ones.

self_named.description: Evidence symbols whose own declaration name carries a separator-delimited id such as tc_391 or tc-391. ABSENT when zero. This subpopulation prevents bindings through comments or attributes from masking a broken test-name form (#367).

self_named_bound.description: Self-named evidence symbols whose declaration line was read by a declared legacy name form. ABSENT when zero; comment and attribute bindings do not increment it.

forms.description: Every declared form consulted for this language, marker names before legacy — the list to check when `bound` is 0 and `candidates` is not.

unbound_example.description: ABSENT when every candidate bound — which is also when no binding diagnostic fires — so a report over a fully-bound corpus keeps the shape an engine predating this field emitted (FR-050-AC-7). Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

unmatched_example.description: One deterministic path and line whose evidence symbol carries an id-shaped token but minted no verifies relation. Absent when no authored tag was missed.

self_named_unbound_example.description: One deterministic self-named evidence symbol no declared name form read. Absent when every self-named symbol bound or no such symbol exists.

reference.description: The declaration that produced the row.

row_id.description: The row's own id, when the declaration names a `row_id_column`.

target_ids.description: Trace ids the row is answerable for — its own plus the ids it references — none of which any symbol backs.

line.description: 1-based document line of the matrix row (#210). Additive under FR-055-CON-3: absent on a payload from an engine predating the field.
1-based document line of the matrix row (#210). Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

reference.description: The declaration that produced the row.

status.description: The authored status value, verbatim. No class is carried: having none is the finding.

line.description: 1-based document line of the matrix row (#210). Duplicate byte-identical rows still collapse to one record (CR-086), which carries the first duplicate's line. Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

test_type.description: The declared test-type value that exempts the row.

line.description: 1-based document line of the matrix row (#210). Additive under FR-055-CON-3.
1-based declaration line of the tagged symbol (#210). Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

trace_id.description: The trace id, exactly as the binding forms yield it.

symbols.description: The distinct binding symbols, ordered by (path, symbol). Always at least two — a uniquely bound id mints no record.

target.description: Declared target kind the ids belong to.

by_property.description: Criteria per property-shape label. Key order is deterministic (NFR-006).

specific_shaped.description: FR-050-AC-28 (CR-095, #230): extractable criteria whose shape names WHAT property to write — every shape but the `universal` catch-all, `example` and `unclassified`. ABSENT — never 0 — for a document whose every extractable criterion is `universal`, which keeps FR-050-AC-7 byte-identity. Not a quality ranking: a `universal` criterion is often the right thing to write.

grounding.description: FR-050-AC-28 (CR-095, #230): per shape label, how many of its records carry the domain/precondition/oracle spans a generator needs. The shapes that say the most carried the least — 65 of 67 specific-shape non-`example` records had zero spans — so `spec-correctness` could not be driven from the very records that named a property worth writing. Key order is deterministic (NFR-006).

catch_all_example.description: ABSENT unless this document has extractable criteria and a specific shape for NONE of them — which is also the only time anything reads it — so a document with any specifically-shaped criterion keeps the bytes an engine predating the field emitted (FR-050-AC-7). Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

declaration.description: The declaration's name, as the model authored it.

reason.description: Stable machine token, shared with `quire validate`'s bundle warnings. Deliberately NOT an enum here: the reason vocabulary is engine data that grows, and a schema that closed it would reject a payload from a newer engine that a consumer could otherwise read.

line.description: agent-ix/quoin#239: one-based source line at the smallest repair locus, when the engine computed one. Absent when the diagnostic is genuinely document- or model-scoped.

value.description: FR-054-AC-12 (CR-091, #179): the vocabulary or catalog value the diagnostic is about, verbatim, when it is about exactly one. `uncatalogued-verification-method` carries the authored method here — the identical string the Obligation records carry in `method` — so a consumer distinguishes an uncatalogued value from a genuine method disagreement by an equality join instead of parsing the message (quoin#168). Absent when the diagnostic is not about one value. Additive under FR-055-CON-3.

subject.description: The affected row, declaration, metric, criterion, or symbol. Additive under FR-055-CON-3; current producers emit the complete guidance group.

change_target.description: The source or configuration surface an operator should inspect or change.

remedy.description: A prescribed repair when the producer has enough evidence to recommend one safely. Mutually exclusive with next_diagnostic_step.

next_diagnostic_step.description: A safe investigation step when the producer cannot choose a trustworthy repair. Mutually exclusive with remedy.

field.description: The frontmatter field whose schema `enum` is the vocabulary.

check.description: The declared `<check>` severity token, joining the record to the warning stream's findings.

value.description: The vocabulary value, verbatim from the schema enum.

state.description: owned: a projected document claims it (wins when a value is both claimed and recorded absent). excused: the declared justified-absence field records it; whether the excuse is justified is verdict policy and deliberately not stated here (FR-059-CON-2). unowned: neither. Closed deliberately, unlike CoverageDiagnostic.reason — the states are the check's own semantics, not a growing vocabulary.

documents.description: Scope-relative documents (`/`-separated on every platform) that decide the state: the claimants for owned, the justified-absence recorders for excused, empty for unowned.

source.description: The obligation source declaration that minted this record.

id.description: The row's own id, or one rendered from `id_format`.

statement.description: The normative statement, verbatim and untruncated.

statement_hash.description: SHA-256 of the NFC/trim/whitespace-collapsed statement. Suspect-link detection is `current != hash_at_binding` and nothing more.

method.description: Declared verification method, trailing annotation stripped.

parameters.description: Declared parameters. An absent key means the cell was empty — never defaulted.

target_ids.description: Test-case ids the method cell names, e.g. `Test (TC-707)`. Additive in v1: absent on a payload from an engine before quire-rs v0.35.0, and omitted where the cell names none. A consumer binding evidence keyed on a TEST CASE rather than on the criterion needs this join, which the engine parsed and discarded (agent-ix/quire-rs#180).

ImplementsRecord.description: FR-062: one requirement -> production-code edge. SCOPE, not evidence — which requirement a production symbol is about. A consumer must not fold this into a backed set or a coverage total; doing so lets unverified code claim coverage, which is the backdoor CR-061 closed.

criteria.description: All-or-nothing pair with `property_shaped`: both present for a corpus binding criteria, both absent otherwise. Zero is a real value; absent is not zero.

specific_shaped.description: FR-050-AC-28 (CR-095, #230): the honest half of the headline, present alongside `criteria` and `property_shaped`. `515/951 extractable (54%)` reads as 'half this specification is property-testable'; 440 of those 515 were the `universal` catch-all and the figure for 'the classifier said what property to write' was 78/951 — 8%. Both true; only one is what a reader repeats.

all_three.description: Records carrying all three — the set `spec-correctness` can actually be driven from.

kind.description: `vacuous-under-guard`: every assertion sits behind a narrowing guard, so an input that does not enter it passes unchecked — the shape of a suite measured green while checking 2.3% of its samples. `oracle-resembles-implementation`: the oracle closely resembles the code it judges, so it asserts only that the code equals itself.

evidence.description: The numbers behind the claim, rendered. Not decoration: a suspicion a reader cannot check in one look is one they learn to scroll past, which is how an advisory check becomes noise rather than a skeptic.

UnboundSymbol.description: One evidence symbol that bound nothing, so `no-symbol-bound` names a place instead of a language (#256). The lowest `(path, line)` among the unbound, so it is deterministic under NFR-006 and does not move when a file is renamed. ONE example, not all of them: the finding is about the language's convention, and a diagnostic carrying a thousand paths is a diagnostic nobody reads.

path.description: Repo-relative, `/`-separated, matching every other path in this payload.

line.description: 1-based line of the symbol's ANNOTATION block, not its declaration line: a marker that failed to match is written where the annotation is, and that is the line the reader has to edit.

symbol.description: Qualified name, so a reader can confirm the same symbol after a file moves.

CatchAllCriterion.description: One extractable criterion the classifier gave the `universal` catch-all, so `catch-all-universal` names a place instead of only a ratio (#261). The lowest-lined such criterion of a document that has no specifically-shaped one.

row_id.description: The criterion's own id, ABSENT when the table declares no id column — never guessed.
